page_title: VAL 2-3 CEL | Valencia v Celta Vigo 05/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Luis Rioja (Valencia) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
90+5' Iosu Galech interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo). That's a free kick to Valencia.
90+3' 2 - 3 Goal! Umar Sadiq provides Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 2:3.
90+2' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
88' Substitution. Oscar Mingueza leaves the pitch and is replaced by Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo).
87' Eray Comert (Valencia) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
87' The referee signals a corner kick to Valencia.

84' Iosu Galech shows a yellow card to Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) for his blatant foul.
83' A terrific attempt by Umar Sadiq (Valencia) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.

81' 1 - 3 A superb goal from great team play! Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
